title: Vision of a rocket exploding at launch

tellings.quote: one time I I saw um a missile um uh being launched

plain: Sometime between 1990 and 1993, while on duty in a work van at his base, Dan Sherman says he had a vision of a missile being launched and blowing up, possibly a Chinese rocket. Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency, hired him to talk with aliens, tells it as his own experience and in his book Above Black, as a sign that the contact also showed him real events.
